player_prompt.intro: Waxaad tahay Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ({role}) ee ciyaarta Pennies ee u dhigma wareega {num_rounds}. - Wareeg kasta, gudbi [heads] ama [tails] (ama [h], [t]). - Haddii doorashadaadu u dhigmaan s ee kaa soo horjeeda, Ciyaaryahanka 0 ayaa guuleysta wareega; haddii kale Ciyaaryahanka 1 ayaa guuleysta. Ku jawaab doorashadaada qaabka '[heads]' ama '[tails]

invalid_move.wrong_format: Qaab aan sax ahayn; fadlan ku qor "[heads]" ama "[tails]".

message.round_match: Ciyaaryahanka 0 ayaa doortay {choice0}; Ciyaaryahanka 1 ayaa doortay {choice1}. Ciyaarta -> Ciyaaryahanka 0 ayaa guuleysta
message.round_mismatch: Ciyaaryahanka 0 wuxuu doortay {choice0}; Ciyaaryahanka 1 wuxuu doortay {choice1}. Iswaafajinta -> Ciyaaryahanka 1 ayaa guuleysta.

outcome.p0_wins: Ciyaaryahanka eberka ah ayaa ku guuleystay wareegyo badan.
